name: coderifts-api-governance
description: Signed, offline-verifiable authorization for AI-agent contract changes. Cursor asks before a contract change proceeds; only a granted change can proceed. The verdict is deterministic — the same change set yields the same verdict, not a model's judgement — and branching is fail-closed: an unrecognised execution_action is not permission. Three MCP tools: preflight_change_set, verify_receipt, get_decision_details.

CODERIFTS_API_KEY.title: CodeRifts API key
CODERIFTS_API_KEY.description: Bearer token from https://coderifts.com. Discovery (initialize, tools/list) works without it; tool calls that require auth need Authorization: Bearer <key>.
